matches.rationale: The finding attacks exactly the inference the ground truth identifies as broken: it exhibits φ = x^3+1 whose points of ramification index d are both 0 and ∞ (equal ramification degrees) yet which is not conjugate to x^d — i.e. equal ramification degrees do not yield the claimed vanishing/power-map conclusion. Although it labels the locus as the Introduction's reduction, the material pointed at is the same flawed ramification-at-0-and-∞ argument.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Its counterexample targets the same invalid step from equal ramification degrees at 0 and ∞ to the power-map conclusion.
